NBA.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
NBA.fold_policy: Original shared 40/60/80 percent expanding date folds

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

NBA.note: Twenty-one fixed adaptive candidates against the prior development winner, compared on shared expanding pre-final-test dates. Selection is optimistic; only the separate future gate can change production weights.

confirmation.note: Historical confirmation of specifications selected on pre-July 2025 results, both trained on the same recent history. The current season and original archived test are excluded. This is not prospective promotion evidence.
